messages:
Priya (AM): Heads-up: new POC with MediTrust. They insist on fully isolated install (no internet), signed USB media, FIPS HSM, and proof of no outbound telemetry. Target start: 2026-06-01.
Evan (SE): Noted. Do they want full-image installs or operator-managed minis? Which kernel/OS baseline?
Priya (AM): They said RHEL8 baseline only. Prefer minimal footprint. Also asked for clear rollback and acceptance tests.
Noah (Security): For RHEL8 airgap we usually produce: signed container/image bundle + signed RPM deltas. Need SBOM, signature chain (notary v2), and HSM-backed signing. Secure boot is requested?
Priya (AM): Yes, they asked for secure boot + attestation during install.
Evan (SE): Plan A: full signed bundle on encrypted USB + installer runs local verification (sha256 + notary verify) + offline preflight. Plan B: delta-mode where we ship a base image once and subsequent monthly delta RPMs. Plan B reduces media size but requires base integrity verification.
Tess (Finance): Pricing question: customer wants fixed POC fee + per-shipment handling. Can we do 30-day free trial credit and $X per-shipment? Also they may require extended documentation for compliance which is billable.
Noah (Security): Compliance docs: we can provide SBOM + manifest + install attestation template. For HSM import, vendor must perform key import under supervised ops. We'll require operator attestation form and chain-of-custody record.
Evan (SE): About upgrade cadence: MediTrust prefers monthly security patches, semi-annual feature upgrades. We should propose: monthly minibundles (security hotfixes), quarterly cumulative deltas, biannual full bundle for major releases. Rollback window: expected 20-45 minutes for a minibundle; full bundle rollback depends on DB migration (could be hours).
Priya (AM): They want SLA: security fix availability within 60 days of disclosure for medium/high. Is that something we can promise?
Noah (Security): 60 days is tight but possible for high/critical if they sign up for the compliance add-on and allow expedited signing ops. Otherwise standard is 90 days. We'll flag this in SOW.
Tess (Finance): Also need per-node pricing for Dedicated license during POC; they'll use 6 nodes. Draft numbers and a refundable deposit for physical media.
Evan (SE): Acceptance criteria to provide: 1) successful offline install on test node, 2) checksum/manifest verification, 3) E2E inference test (sample prompts), 4) audit log for HSM key import, 5) proof of telemetry opt-out. Provide rollback script and test plan.
deploy-bot: Artifact uploaded 2026-04-22T09:12:03Z: meditrust-airgap-2026.04.22.tar.gz (sha256: ef12b3c4a5..).
Priya (AM): @Evan draft the acceptance checklist and shipping cost breakdown. @Tess prepare provisional quote with handling fee and deposit. I'll schedule sync with MediTrust for Thursday 10am PT.
Evan (SE): Will draft. Quick Q: do we support USB with tamper-evident seals?
Noah (Security): Yes, we can include tamper-evident packaging and a signed manifest sealed into the media. Operator must verify seal and manifest before install.
Tess (Finance): I'll add an optional line item for accelerated patching (customer pays for ops overtime for emergency CVE signing/shipping).
Priya (AM): Great. Bring SOW draft and sample SBOM to Thurs sync. Thanks everyone.
